title: Escape from Fogharbor
opening: The tide is coming. Find your companions, cross the guard gallery and decide Fogharbor’s fate.

art.description: A damp stone prison with traces of seaweed on rough walls. An open central area is bordered by iron cages and a control console. Keep passageways clear.
art.style: Realistic fantasy tactical map, directly overhead
art.materials: Rough stone, iron bars and bronze
art.lighting: Listed warm wall lamps against cool ambient light; clear floor and exit boundaries

scenes.name: Tidal Cells
scenes.description: Waves strike the stone walls. A mechanism beside the cage still glimmers.
scenes.intro: Waves strike the stone walls. A mechanism beside the cage still glimmers.

appearance.label: Cage control console
appearance.description: A worn bronze lever set into a low stone console

points.name: Rescue the scholar
points.text: The scholar steps out of the open cage.
points.success: The cage opens. The scholar nods gratefully to the rescuers.
points.failure: The catch does not release. Another approach is needed.

art.description: A long harbor guard gallery with salt-stained, worn stone tiles. Wooden benches and the listed hanging lamps line the walls; the central passage stays clear.
art.style: Realistic fantasy tactical map, directly overhead
art.materials: Rough stone, iron bars and bronze
art.lighting: Listed warm wall lamps against cool ambient light; clear floor and exit boundaries

scenes.name: Guard Gallery
scenes.description: Footsteps echo from the end of the gallery. A severed wire hangs beside the alarm bell.
scenes.intro: Footsteps echo from the end of the gallery. A severed wire hangs beside the alarm bell.

appearance.label: Bronze bell and pull rope
appearance.description: A bronze bell hangs from a wall bracket, with a thick rope dangling toward the floor

points.name: Alarm-bell switch
points.success: The alarm rings. Two guards appear at their configured positions.

points.name: Disable the alarm wire
points.success: The wire is secured without a sound.
points.failure: The wire snaps back and rings the alarm. Harbor guards answer the sound.

art.description: A timber-and-stone waterfront dock. Mist covers the distant water. An empty skiff lies moored beside ropes and wooden bollards.
art.style: Realistic fantasy tactical map, directly overhead
art.materials: Damp planks, stone steps and coarse rope
art.lighting: Listed warm wall lamps against cool ambient light; clear floor and exit boundaries

scenes.name: Fogharbor Dock
scenes.description: One skiff remains moored in the fog.
scenes.intro: One skiff remains moored in the fog.

points.name: Conflict trigger
points.text: The GM verifies participants, sides and initiative before starting the conflict.

points.name: Escape by boat
points.success: The party casts off and sails into the mist. The adventure ends in escape.

points.name: Stay and keep watch
points.success: The party stays at the dock to await the next tide. The adventure ends with their vigil.

npcs.name: Irena, the captive scholar
npcs.knowledge: Knows the gallery leads to the dock.
npcs.secret: Once charted routes for harbor smugglers.
npcs.dialogue: Help me open this cage first.

npcs.name: Lorn, the harbor keeper
npcs.description: An old sailor keeping watch over Fogharbor.
npcs.knowledge: There are two ways forward from the dock.

arrivals.name: Alarm reinforcements
arrivals.intro: Two harbor guards respond to the alarm.

broadcasts.title: GM note
broadcasts.text: Escape and staying are alternative endings. Confirm the party’s choice before triggering the corresponding interaction. Do not apply both endings to the same game.
